title: Technical architect-Agentic AI
description:
Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for a testing agentic AI platform, including multi\-agent orchestration, tool interfaces, safety, observability, and scalable deployment.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Define multi\-agent system architecture (planner, executor, memory, tool adapters) and governance
* Design tool\-use layer (APIs, search, code, test frameworks) with secure sandboxing, enabling agentic systems to operate via tools and feedback loops
* Establish evaluation and safety architecture (guardrails, red\-teaming, policy engines) for non\-deterministic behavior with human\-in\-the\-loop review
* Select model strategy (proprietary vs OSS), vector/store strategy, and retrieval patterns
* Drive platform non\-functionals: reliability, latency, cost, observability, and data privacy
* Collaborate with PO/AI Lead on roadmap and technical debt; work with product teams to design, test, and deploy AI capabilities



  





**Technical Skills** 



* LLM/Agent Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-calling, function calling
* Retrieval \& Memory: Vector databases (FAISS, Milvus, pgvector), embeddings
* Evaluation/LLMOps: Prompt versioning, offline/online evaluations, MLflow, Weights \& Biases (W\&B), feature stores
* Systems: Distributed services, event\-driven architecture, gRPC/REST APIs, Kubernetes, Terraform, observability
* Security \& Compliance: Data governance, PII handling, secrets management, guardrails



  





**Domain Skills** 



* Software testing / QA platforms
* Test orchestration and CI/CD integration
* Agentic behavior patterns
* Test generation and coordination at scale



  





 Experience: 16\+ years
 



 Work location: Chennai/Hyderabad/Mumbai/Pune

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
**Position –**

 AI Architect

**Location –**

**About the Company** 




 Movate is a new age services company that harnesses the power of digital technologies to reimagine customer engagements. We enable businesses to anticipate and face disruptions effectively through our digital, technology and support services. We are a global customer experience and technology consulting services provider and a digital transformation partner of choice for its clients, which include the world’s top innovators across industries, from mid\-market players to large enterprises. We have a diverse team of over 11,500 customer\-centric thinkers, collaborators, and co creators across 20 global locations.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the architecture, development, and enterprise adoption of AI solutions for a leading US Healthcare customer. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and governing secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI solutions leveraging Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and traditional AI/ML technologies. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with architectural leadership to build enterprise AI platforms, establish engineering standards, and guide cross\-functional teams in delivering high\-impact AI solutions across healthcare domains such as member engagement, claims, prior authorization, document intelligence, and operational automation.
 



  





**Key Skills\-** 
 Generative AI, LLM, RAG, Agentic AI, AI Architecture, Python, Fast API, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vector Databases, Elasticsearch, Enterprise AI Security, Responsible AI, HIPAA, FHIR, X12/EDI, Kubernetes, Docker, Cloud Architecture.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Enterprise AI Architecture \& Development** 




  





 • Lead the architecture, design, and development of enterprise\-grade AI solutions for US Healthcare use cases.
 



 • Define and own the enterprise AI architecture roadmap aligned with business and technology strategy.
 



 • Design, develop, and oversee the implementation of Generative AI, LLM, Agentic AI, and RAG\-based applications from proof of concept through production deployment.
 



 • Architect end\-to\-end AI solutions covering data ingestion, document processing, embeddings, vector search, reranking, LLM orchestration, APIs, and application integration.
 



 • Establish reusable AI architecture patterns, reference implementations, coding standards, and development best practices across multiple projects.
 



 • Review solution designs and provide hands\-on technical guidance during development, integration, testing, and production deployment.
 



 • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms for enterprise adoption.
 



  





**Enterprise AI Security \& Governance** 




 • Define and implement enterprise AI security best practices across the entire AI application lifecycle, including design, development, deployment, and operations.
 



 • Architect secure AI solutions with robust controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, and secure API integrations.
 



 • Design safeguards against AI\-specific threats such as prompt injection, jailbreak attacks, data leakage, model misuse, insecure tool calling, and adversarial inputs.
 



 • Implement enterprise guardrails including content filtering, input/output validation, PII/PHI protection, data masking, policy enforcement, and audit controls.
 



 • Ensure AI solutions comply with HIPAA, enterprise security standards, and Responsible AI governance principles.
 



 • Conduct AI threat modeling, architecture risk assessments, security reviews, and vulnerability assessments for AI solutions.
 



 • Establish governance processes for model lifecycle management, prompt versioning, evaluation, monitoring, observability, and AI risk management.
 



  





**AI Platform Engineering** 




 • Design and oversee the development of scalable AI platforms supporting multiple business applications.
 



 • Build and optimize enterprise RAG architectures with advanced retrieval strategies, hybrid search, vector databases, and contextual retrieval.
 



 • Design AI agent frameworks with secure tool orchestration and enterprise workflow integration.
 



 • Define integration patterns for enterprise systems, APIs, databases, document repositories, and cloud services.
 



 • Drive performance optimization, scalability, reliability, observability, and cost optimization of AI platforms.
 



  





**Technical Leadership** 




 • Provide technical leadership across multiple AI programs while mentoring AI Tech Leads, senior engineers, and development teams.
 



 • Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and design reviews to ensure high\-quality, secure, and maintainable AI solutions.
 



 • Collaborate with enterprise architects, security teams, product owners, healthcare domain experts, and engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
 



 • Support solution design, customer workshops, technical proposals, and architecture discussions with business stakeholders.
 



 • Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, AI Engineering, and enterprise AI security frameworks, driving adoption of industry best practices.

 • Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, or Hugging Face.
 



  





**Programming \& Backend Development** 




 • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building production\-grade AI applications.
 



 • Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
 



 • Strong understanding of microservices, asynchronous processing, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.

**AI \& Data Technologies**

title: Principal Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 Principal Architect for a multinational organization responsible for designing scalable generative AI platforms using AWS services guiding complex solution architectures and ensuring secure reliable and cost efficient deployments. The role focuses on strategic design technical governance and enabling teams to deliver impactful AI solutions within a hybrid work model.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design end to end generative AI architectures that align with enterprise standards and enable scalable intelligent solutions that address complex business problems across multiple domains.
* Develop robust solution blueprints that integrate generative AI models with existing systems and data pipelines to deliver reliable and reusable AI capabilities.
* Architect cloud native solutions using AWS services with emphasis on CloudFormation templates to ensure consistent automated and compliant infrastructure provisioning.
* Optimize AWS machine learning workflows by defining patterns for training tuning deploying and monitoring models to achieve efficient performance and resource utilization.
* Collaborate with product teams to translate business requirements into detailed technical designs that leverage generative AI and AWS machine learning services in a practical manner.
* Define reference architectures and best practices for generative AI including data preparation model selection prompt design and evaluation to promote high quality outcomes.
* Establish governance for infrastructure as code using CloudFormation to maintain security compliance and configuration consistency across environments.
* Guide teams in adopting secure design principles for AI workloads including data protection access control observability and responsible AI practices.
* Review solution designs and implementation plans to identify risks gaps and optimization opportunities while ensuring adherence to architectural standards.
* Drive performance optimization for AI and machine learning workloads by analyzing usage patterns and recommending improvements in scaling storage and compute strategies.
* Coordinate with platform and operations teams to ensure high availability resilience and disaster recovery readiness for critical AI solutions deployed on AWS.
* Document architectural decisions patterns and guidelines in a clear and reusable manner to support knowledge sharing and onboarding of new team members.
* Engage with stakeholders to communicate architectural options tradeoffs and recommendations that align with organizational strategy and deliver measurable value.


**Qualifications**
* Require extensive hands on experience designing and implementing generative AI solutions including model integration prompt engineering and lifecycle management in production environments.
* Require strong proficiency with AWS CloudFormation including authoring modular templates managing stacks and enforcing infrastructure automation practices.
* Require proven expertise with AWS machine learning services such as SageMaker and related tools covering data preparation training deployment and monitoring of models.
* Require solid background in distributed systems microservices and event driven architectures to ensure that AI solutions are scalable secure and maintainable.
* Require demonstrated experience working in hybrid work environments collaborating effectively with distributed teams using remote friendly communication and delivery practices.
* Nice to have prior exposure to MLOps tools and frameworks to streamline continuous integration continuous delivery and monitoring for machine learning and generative AI workflows.
* Nice to have experience with data governance data quality and metadata management practices to ensure that training and inference data used by AI solutions remains trustworthy.
* Nice to have experience mentoring technical teams on AI and cloud architecture topics and contributing to internal communities of practice focused on innovation.
* Nice to have industry knowledge in domains such as finance retail or healthcare which can help shape practical and responsible applications of generative AI.
* Nice to have awareness of ethical AI guidelines and regulatory considerations to ensure that generative AI solutions respect fairness transparency and accountability expectations.


**Certifications Required**
 No.

title: Product Security Architect
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Logitech's product ecosystem spans embedded hardware, desktop software, and cloud services, and the security of everything we build sits at the heart of what this team does.
   

  

 As a
 **Product Security Architect** 
 , you will work across Logitech's full portfolio of internally built and self\-hosted applications, providing security architecture guidance, threat modeling expertise, and hands\-on consultancy to engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
   

  

 Your scope will deliberately span both product and enterprise software. Whether you are reviewing the secure design of a companion desktop application or advising on the authentication architecture of an internal enterprise service, you will be the security voice that engineering teams turn to before problems emerge.
   

  

 You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and fellow security team members, using a combination of deep technical expertise and modern AI\-assisted tooling to embed security early and at scale across Logitech's engineering organization.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

 Secure Architecture \& Design
   

  

* Define and own the secure architecture standards across Logitech's in\-house built and self\-hosted applications, spanning product ecosystems and enterprise services
* Design secure communication pathways, trust boundaries, authentication frameworks, and cryptographic standards across our full software stack
* Establish reusable, scalable security patterns that engineering teams can adopt without slowing down delivery


 Threat Modeling \& Risk Advisory
   

  

* Lead threat modeling exercises across new and existing products, leveraging AI models to accelerate baseline generation and focusing your expertise on complex, Logitech\-specific attack vectors
* Identify architectural risks early in the SDLC and translate them into clear, prioritized, and actionable engineering requirements
* Maintain a living view of our internal threat landscape and evolving attack surfaces, including AI\-integrated product features


 Internal Security Consultancy
   

  

* Serve as the trusted security partner for Product Managers, Lead Engineers, and Engineering Directors during ideation and design phases
* Drive security reviews and design consultations across multiple product squads simultaneously, ensuring security remains an accelerator rather than a blocker
* Define testing scopes and critical attack paths to guide offensive security and validation efforts


 AI Feature \& Integration Security
   

  

* Act as the primary security authority for AI features being embedded into Logitech products and services — including on\-device ML models, cloud\-hosted LLM integrations, and AI data pipelines
* Define security guardrails for generative AI integrations, covering risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, and training data exposure


 What You Bring
   

  

**Experience**
* 6\+ years in Application Security, Product Security, or Security Architecture roles covering a diverse and complex software portfolio
* Demonstrated experience designing secure architectures across both product\-facing and enterprise internal applications
* Track record of influencing engineering culture and embedding security practices early in the development lifecycle


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Deep expertise in threat modeling methodologies
* Strong command of modern authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC) and secure API design principles
* Solid understanding of cryptographic fundamentals and their practical application in software systems
* Familiarity with cloud\-native security architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and self\-hosted infrastructure security
* Working knowledge of secure SDLC frameworks (OWASP SAMM or equivalent)


 AI \& Modern Security Practices
   

  

* Practical experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate threat modeling, architecture reviews, or security research
* Understanding of AI/ML security risks, including adversarial inputs, model extraction, prompt injection, and data pipeline security


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Exceptional communication skills — you can speak to a firmware engineer and a VP of Engineering in the same day and be equally effective with both
* Strong consultancy mindset: you influence without authority and build long\-term trust with engineering teams


 Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on\-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in\-house.
   

  

 Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
   

  

 We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
   

  

 If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at \+1\-510\-713\-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Lead - Solution Engineer
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us***



**Job Description**

 Freshservice is expanding what “AI\-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.
   

  





 This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands\-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post\-sale. You'll be the AI subject\-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.
   

  





 You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs\-of\-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent\-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal\-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof\-of\-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de\-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business\-case models that the wider SE team can self\-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one\-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go\-to expert.


**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**



* 8\+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands\-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM\-based solutions in a customer\-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG\-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production\-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one\-size\-fits\-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof\-of\-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX\-leader audience or down to a hands\-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.



**Nice to Have**



* Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.
* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42\) and how it feeds AI\-driven automation.
* Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.
* A builder's instinct — you'd rather stand up a working demo than a slide.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**CTM Senior Manager – Application Security**
**Overview**
 As part of our Cyber Security team, you will help secure applications and platforms while ensuring seamless development, build, and deployment capabilities. You will be responsible for designing secure software by identifying security use cases during the design and development stages, including emerging risks from AI/ML\-enabled applications. You will work closely with DevOps, architects, developers, and QA teams to build highly reliable and secure products. You will also coach development teams on building a strong security culture and provide recommendations on vulnerabilities, secure development practices, and the responsible adoption of AI\-driven technologies.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Senior Manager – Application Security \& DevSecOps to lead high\-impact application security engagements for enterprise clients. You will drive delivery, mentor teams, expand client relationships, and shape practice offerings across Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Threat Modeling, and AI/ML security.
   

  

 This role involves enabling organizations to securely adopt GenAI and AI\-driven solutions, ensuring risks are effectively managed while supporting innovation. This is a client\-facing leadership role requiring both strong technical depth and executive\-level communication.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client Delivery \& Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end application security assessments (SAST/DAST/SCA, penetration testing, secure code review, threat modeling).
* Design and implement Secure SDLC frameworks for Agile/DevOps environments.
* Advise CISOs and CTOs on application security strategy, roadmaps, and ROI.
* Manage large multi\-workstream engagements.
* Advise clients on secure adoption of AI/ML and GenAI solutions, including risk assessments, governance, and secure enterprise integration.
* Lead client\-facing engagements to assess and secure AI/ML applications, providing strategic direction on risk management, governance, and mitigation of vulnerabilities such as prompt injection and data exposure.


**Practice Development**
* Develop proprietary methodologies, accelerators, and IP in AppSec (e.g., AI\-driven secure coding, intelligent vulnerability prioritization, zero\-trust application architecture).
* Contribute to thought leadership — whitepapers, webinars, conference talks (Black Hat, RSA, OWASP).
* Support proposal development and deal closure for strategic pursuits.
* Build and enhance AI security offerings, including GenAI security frameworks and AI risk governance models.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Mentor and performance\-manage a team of 20–25 consultants (Managers, Seniors, Analysts).
* Build high\-performing, diverse teams with a focus on technical excellence and client empathy.
* Drive utilization, training, and career development.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience building enterprise\-scale AppSec and DevSecOps programs from the ground up.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI technologies and their application in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of AI/ML security risks (model poisoning, prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks) and mitigation techniques.
* Familiarity with secure AI adoption practices, including governance, model lifecycle security, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience contributing to thought leadership, research, or open\-source initiatives in application security.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST SSDF).
* Executive presence — ability to influence CxOs and translate complex technical risks into business outcomes.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE / B.Tech / MCA.
* Minimum of 12\+ years of experience in application security, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, or security architecture.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Prior experience in a Big 4 or similar consulting environment as a Manager / Senior Manager.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Manager – Technology M\&A Advisory
   

  

 Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting opportunity to help leading global organizations navigate the technology dimensions of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, and joint ventures.
   

  

 Practice: Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network \| Area of Work: Technology M\&A \| Level: Manager \| Location: Bangalore/Gurgaon/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Kolkata \| Years of Experience: 8–15 years
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you enjoy solving complex business and technology challenges? Are you passionate about helping clients create value through successful integrations and separations? Do you thrive in fast\-paced transaction environments and enjoy working with senior executives to drive critical business outcomes?
   

  

 Then this is the right place for you.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 The Technology M\&A team helps clients navigate the technology implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, joint ventures, and business transformations. We work across the transaction lifecycle, with a strong focus on post\-deal signing activities including sign\-to\-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy and exit planning, and execution through Integration Management Offices (IMO) and Separation Management Offices (SMO).
   

  

 Our professionals help clients identify and realize transaction value while managing technology risks, operational dependencies, and transformation opportunities. We work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to design and execute integration and separation strategies that enable successful transaction outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technology workstreams across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, and separation engagements.
* Support clients through sign\-to\-close planning activities, identifying technology risks, dependencies, synergies, and execution requirements.
* Develop Day 1 readiness strategies and support Day 1 execution planning.
* Drive technology integration and separation planning across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity, data, and operating models.
* Support Integration Management Office (IMO) and Separation Management Office (SMO) governance, planning, execution tracking, and stakeholder management.
* Develop TSA strategies, transition plans, service schedules, and TSA exit roadmaps.
* Assess technology costs, risks, synergies, and implementation dependencies associated with transactions.
* Facilitate decision\-making with senior client stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* Lead teams in delivering technology M\&A programs and manage project financials, staffing, and delivery quality.
* Develop executive\-level presentations, steering committee materials, business cases, and transaction\-related recommendations.


**Bring Your Best Skills Forward**
* Strong experience across Technology M\&A engagements including integration planning, IT Synergy assessments, separation planning, carve\-outs, Day 1 readiness, TSA management, and post\-merger integration activities.
* Ability to connect transaction objectives with technology execution plans and value realization opportunities.
* Experience managing technology workstreams within complex transaction environments and coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop practical, actionable recommendations.
* Experience leading teams and managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.


**Technology Domain Experience**
 Candidates should possess practical experience in at least one of the following technology domains and understand how these capabilities evolve during M\&A transactions, integrations, and separations:
   

  

* IT Infrastructure \& Cloud
* Infrastructure integration and separation planning.
* Cloud migration and cloud operating model considerations.
* Data center, network, workplace, hosting, and end\-user computing environments.
* Infrastructure TSA planning and exit execution.
* ERP
* Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP platforms.
* ERP integration, harmonization, migration, or carve\-out activities.
* Understanding of business process impacts, reporting, controls, and data migration considerations during transactions.
* Enterprise Architecture \& IT Operating Model Transformation
* Enterprise architecture assessments and target\-state design.
* Application portfolio rationalization and technology roadmap development.
* IT operating model design and transformation.
* Technology governance, capability models, and organizational design considerations during integrations and separations.


 Deep SME\-level technical expertise is not required; however, candidates should possess sufficient hands\-on experience to assess transaction impacts, identify dependencies and risks, and support planning and execution activities within their chosen technology domain.
   

  

**What’s in it for You?**
* Opportunity to work on high\-profile global M\&A transactions and transformative business programs.
* Exposure to senior client executives and strategic decision\-making processes.
* Collaboration with leading practitioners across Technology Strategy, M\&A, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Industry groups.
* Personalized training and development programs to strengthen transaction, consulting, and leadership capabilities.
* A diverse and inclusive culture focused on innovation, growth, and continuous learning.


**About Accenture:**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. title: IT Security Manager - IAM Architect / Lead
description:
Wolters Kluwer Global Business Services (GBS) is designed to provide services to the business units in the areas of technology, sourcing, procurement, legal, finance, and human resources. These global centers promote team collaboration using best practices around a specific focus area to drive results and enhance operational efficiencies. There is a constant endeavor to benchmark against best\-in\-class industry standards to improve the quality of deliverables, increase cost savings, enhance productivity and reduce time to market for products and applications.
   

  

 We have an amazing opportunity for a IAM lead architect, IT Security available within our Global Business Services division. This position has been created due to growth. IAM lead Architect, IT Security will be Accountable and Responsible for defining the identity fabric — the standards, reference architectures, and integration patterns and working closely with project teams as well as internal / external groups to protect and enhance the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Wolters Kluwer assets.
   

  

 This position location is Pune or Chennai, India .
   

  

 As IAM lead Architect, IT Security, you will be accountable for defining IAM architectures, standards, road maps for all our IAM programs to secure access to personal and confidential information at Wolters Kluwer. In this role, you will be required to demonstrate proficiency in identity and access concepts as they pertain to every area of security management. Your role will also include interfacing with all other areas of the security organization and responding to 3rd party audits and internal audits, and interfacing with internal business unit IT representatives on global information security initiatives and compliance tasks and projects.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Define and own the enterprise identity architecture strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards aligned to business and regulatory requirements across US and EU jurisdictions.
* Produce and maintain the IAM RACI — resolving ownership boundaries between Access Management, IGA, Privileged IAM, Access Management, and NHI pillars.
* Establish and govern the IAM Architecture Review Board (ARB), ensuring architectural sign\-off on all material identity, access, and authentication changes.
* Own the identity fabric design — the authoritative directory model, hybrid sync strategy, group and role taxonomy, and attribute schema across AD and Entra ID.
* Define integration standards for all IAM tool\-to\-tool connections: SailPoint to AD, CyberArk to Entra PIM, CIEM to SIEM, and emerging NHI tooling.


 Zero Trust and Cloud IAM Architecture
   

  

* Architect and enforce Zero Trust identity controls across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including least\-privilege, just\-in\-time access, and continuous access evaluation.
* Define cloud IAM governance standards: Entra ID tenant architecture, AWS IAM permission boundaries, Azure RBAC design, and GCP IAM policy structure.
* Drive the architectural strategy for CIEM integration — ensuring cloud entitlement visibility, toxic combination detection, and least\-privilege remediation at scale.
* Own the identity component of the organization’s Zero Trust roadmap, including micro\-segmentation, device trust, and identity\-aware network policy.


 NHI and AI Identity Architecture
   

  

* Define the Non\-Human Identity (NHI) governance architecture — covering service accounts, managed identities, service principals, pipeline identities, and AI agent identities.
* Design the secrets management architecture integrating CyberArk Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, and CI/CD OIDC federation for keyless pipeline authentication.
* Architect the AI agent identity model — defining how AI agents authenticate, what permissions they hold, how their actions are audited, and how their lifecycle is governed.
* Produce architectural guidance for MCP server identity controls and LLM API key governance for emerging AI tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, custom agents).


 Regulatory and Compliance Architecture
   

  

* Ensure identity architecture satisfies GDPR, NIS2, DORA, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27001 requirements across all operating regions.
* Translate evolving regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act, SEC cybersecurity rules) into actionable identity architecture changes.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Data Protection Officers to embed Privacy\-by\-Design and data minimization at the identity architecture layer.
* Maintain the IAM architecture risk register — classifying, prioritizing, and driving remediation of architectural debt and control gaps.


 Cross\-Pillar Governance
   

  

* Serve as the primary architectural authority for the IAM program — covering Access Management and Controls and Audit operationally where dedicated leads are not yet in place.
* Chair the IAM Architecture Guild, fostering a community of practice across distributed identity engineers in US and EU time zones.
* Present identity architecture posture and program progress to the IAM Owner, CISO, and executive leadership.
* Evaluate and govern the IAM toolchain — rationalizing tool overlap, driving consolidation decisions, and managing vendor relationships for identity platforms.


 Our Interview Practices
   

  

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

**Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Individual Contributor to join our team in Chennai. In this role, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of our cutting\-edge Network Operating System (NOS), from initial bring\-up on new hardware platforms to the development and sustenance of advanced networking features. You will be a hands\-on technical expert, working on the core of our networking stack and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-performance, robust, and scalable solutions for our customers.
   

  

 Detailed Description
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform Bring\-up \& System Features: Lead the bring\-up of our NOS on new hardware platforms, including the development and integration of Linux device drivers. Ensure system\-level features such as High Availability (HA) and Stacking are robust and performant.
* NOS Development \& Sustenance: Design, develop, and maintain software for our NOS, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability. This includes troubleshooting and resolving complex issues in the field.
* Network Stack Development: Drive the development of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols. That may need expertise in routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP, as well as other key technologies like MPLS, VXLAN, and QoS. (May not be all the protocols mentioned here)
* Management \& Control Plane: Implement and sustain management interfaces and protocols, including SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, REST, CLI, gNMI, and gRPC, to enable seamless integration with network management systems. (May not be all the protocols mentioned here)
* ASIC/NPU Integration: Leverage your strong experience with Broadcom's XGS/DNX family of devices to develop and optimize software for high\-performance packet forwarding. Experience with Marvell's Innovium/Prestera family is a plus.
* Collaborative Teamwork: Work closely with other engineering teams, QA, and customer\-facing teams to ensure the successful delivery and deployment of our products.


 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

* Experience: A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience as an Individual Contributor in a networking domain.
* Programming Languages: Rich, hands\-on experience with C, C\+\+, Python, and GoLang.
* Networking Expertise:
* In\-depth knowledge of L2/L3 networking protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP).
* Proven experience with MPLS, VXLAN, and QoS.
* Management Protocols: Strong understanding and practical experience with network management protocols and APIs (SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, REST, gNMI, gRPC).
* ASICs: Solid working experience with network processor units (NPUs) from Broadcom (XGS/DNX family).
* NOS Experience: Prior experience in Network Operating System (NOS) development or sustenance is essential. Experience with SONiC NOS is a significant advantage.
* Soft Skills:
* Excellent inter\-working and collaboration skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to work effectively with multiple functional teams and customer\-facing organizations.


 Physical Demands
   

  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.
* Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.
* Occasional travel may be required.


 Typical Experience
   

  

* 6\+ years


 Typical Education
   

  

 Bachelor degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

 Educational Requirements may vary by Geography
   

  

 Notes
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

title: Specialist, Software Technology
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Must have Qualifications:**
* Deep proficiency in core programming concepts, with hands\-on expertise in Java, Python, or C\+\+
* Strong background in object\-oriented design (OOD) and multi\-threaded application development
* Demonstrated experience in full\-stack web development, specializing in microservices architecture, performance optimization, and security best practices
* Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms
* Practical experience with Kubernetes and designing scalable microservices
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills, with strong communication abilities (both verbal and written)
* Ability to bridge theoretical concepts and real\-world implementations
* Experience managing the full product development lifecycle, from concept to deployment
* Experience designing and deploying ML/DL pipelines for training, inference, validation, and monitoring is a plus
* Technical leadership or mentoring experience is a plus
* Exposure to computer vision, signal processing, or time‑series analysis, particularly for high‑volume or high‑resolution data is a plus


**Responsibilities:**
* Design, develop, and maintain ML/DL‑based software solutions \& big\-data analysis for large, complex semiconductor systems
* Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques to semiconductor metrology, inspection, yield analysis, defect classification, and process optimization
* Collaborate with globally distributed teams, including hardware, optics, algorithms, and systems engineers, to deliver high‑impact AI solutions
* Analyze and resolve complex system‑level issues spanning software, ML models, data quality, and hardware interactions
* Drive model performance tuning, robustness, and explainability to meet manufacturing and customer requirements
* Identify root causes of product or process variability and propose innovative ML‑driven solutions
* Support technology transfer from research and prototyping to high‑volume manufacturing environments
* Travel to other company sites and customer locations as required to support deployment, debugging, and adoption
* Participate in end‑to‑end product development lifecycle activities, from design through deployment and support


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
 Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. **Vestas Technology \& Operations \> Research \& Development (R\&D) \> Product Applications \& Controls R\&D \> Turbine Control Software Module \> Technical Management**
 Vestas Technology \& Operations (VTO) brings together R\&D, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality into one integrated organization, ensuring our products meet high standards for quality, efficiency, and time\-to\-market.
   

  

 Within VTO, the “WTG Controls” solution is a team of skilled engineers and specialists across India, Portugal, and Denmark. We organized in SAFe/FlowAgile ARTs and develop advanced software solutions that support the turbine performance including the control system.
   

  

 Our work is rooted in strong systems engineering principles, with a focus on delivering robust, high\-quality software across the full product lifecycle. We take ownership end\-to\-end — from design to delivery — and continuously push the boundaries of what turbine software can achieve.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Software Architect for Turbine Software, you will report to the Module Design Owner for Turbine SW and play a central role in defining and safeguarding the software architecture that powers all Vestas wind turbines. Your key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of high\-performance, safety\-critical embedded software systems primarily developed in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20 and beyond)
* Collaborate across engineering and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment. Define and own the software architecture guidelines for the WTG Control solution with :400 people. Translate business and technical requirements into clear architectural solutions and development guidelines
* Define and enforce coding standards, architectural patterns, and best practices for scalable, maintainable, and testable systems. Write high‑quality, performance, and testable code, and analyze complex legacy and modern codebases to implement fixes and improvements
* Ensure better support for the utilization of AI agentic frameworks for development
* Provide expert troubleshooting and operational support for products, tools, and customer‑reported issues
* Promote continuous integration and automated testing practices for embedded (e.g., unit testing frameworks and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing). Maintain and update comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture descriptions and interface specifications, to support software functionality and lifecycle management
* Drive continuous improvement by enhancing processes, tools, and developing utilities that support operations and maintenance


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Familiarity with software architecture principles, including modular design, layered architecture, and interface\-driven and modular development
* Extensive experience in modern C\+\+ development, with strong knowledge of recent language features (C\+\+17/20 and beyond). Demonstrated experience in a technical leadership role within a large Agile software development organization
* Proven experience in embedded software development preferably in real\-time and/or safety\-critical systems. Knowledge about Docker and Linux. Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps
* Beneficial with knowledge from RTOS2 or other open\-source real\-time operating systems
* General knowledge or experience in Secure Product Development and Cyber Security is beneficial
* Ability and motivation to understand complex technical domains, system behavior, and low\-level software interactions
* Experience with AI agentic frameworks


**Competencies**
 We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates the following competencies and personal attributes:
   

  

* Strong technical leadership within C\+\+ and embedded systems domains, with the ability to guide and mentor engineers
* Proven ability to lead and collaborate with remote, multi‑location teams
* Proficient English communication and interpersonal skills
* Possesses a global mindset with deep cultural understanding
* Applies a systems engineering approach to problem‑solving and decision‑making
* Builds trust and influence through effective leadership and stakeholder management
* Results‑oriented, open‑minded, and thrives in an international, multicultural environment


**What We Offer**
 We offer an exciting opportunity to take full lifecycle responsibility for a key area of the turbine software system. You will join a highly adaptive and empowered team where you are encouraged to make decisions, drive initiatives, and implement your own solutions.
   

  

 In this role, you will build a broad network across a truly global organization, gaining extensive opportunities for cross‑disciplinary collaboration and personal development. You will be part of a result\-oriented environment that maintains a high professional standard and a strong commitment to technical excellence.
   

  

 Most importantly, you will work with a clear sense of purpose—understanding the value of your contributions and how your work directly supports the global effort to address climate change.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Primary work location: Aarhus (Denmark), Porto (Portugal) or Chennai (India)
   

  

 Up to 15 days of travel per year.
   

  

 We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 4th Oct 2026\.
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 185 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
   

  

 With 30,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
   

  

 Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
   

  

 To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC299929
description:

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.

 Job responsibilities

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
 At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**Required Technical Skills** 




 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
 



 Experience supporting large enterprise Oracle database environments is required.
 



 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.

 • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional

description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Gen AI Principal Lead**

With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a POSITION\_NAME, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Lead the transformation of software development lifecycle into an AI\-agentic model — where autonomous and semi\-autonomous AI agents handle defined portions of requirements analysis, coding, testing, code review, and deployment, under a governed human\-oversight framework. Own both the technical architecture and the organizational rollout.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assess the current SDLC end\-to\-end and identify which stages are suitable for agent autonomy, agent\-assist, or remain human\-owned (a maturity/readiness map, not a blanket "automate everything")
* Design and stand up the agentic architecture: agent orchestration layer, tool/permission scoping, approval and escalation gates, integration with existing CI/CD and code review systems
* Define and implement guardrails: security review for agent\-generated code, cost/usage controls, rollback and audit mechanisms, human sign\-off checkpoints for high\-risk changes
* Select and integrate the agent tooling stack (build vs. buy decisions across orchestration frameworks, coding agents, testing agents, deployment agents)
* Run a phased rollout (pilot team → expanded pilot → org\-wide) with clear success metrics at each stage — cycle time, defect rate, agent\-error rate, developer trust/adoption
* Own change management: training engineering teams on new workflows, redefining code\-review and QA roles, working with security/compliance on new risk surfaces
* Report to engineering leadership on ROI, risk, and adoption — with honest calibration of what's actually autonomous vs. assisted


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years software engineering experience, including senior/staff\-level architecture ownership
* Demonstrated production experience with AI agent frameworks and LLM tool\-use patterns
* Deep knowledge of modern SDLC/DevOps tooling and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience leading a cross\-functional technology change initiative (not just a technical build)


**Desirable**
* Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive environment (agent guardrails matter more there)
* Prior consulting/transformation\-program background
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent\-tool integration standards
