* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

title: Job Description
description:
**Job Description** 




 Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant – ServiceNow \& Salesforce
 



 Position Overview
 



 We are looking for an
 **Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant** 
 with hands\-on knowledge of
 **ServiceNow and Salesforce** 
 to configure, administer, automate, integrate, and continuously improve enterprise service management and customer operations platforms.
 



 The successful candidate will work across both platforms, translating business requirements into scalable configurations, workflows, integrations, and governed platform solutions. The role requires a strong understanding of
 **IT Service Management (ITSM), CRM, platform administration, automation, scripting, data security, integration, testing, and release management** 
 .
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ServiceNow Administration \& Configuration
 


* Administer and configure ServiceNow instances, including tables, forms, lists, roles, groups, ACLs, notifications, and scoped applications.
* Configure and support ITSM processes including:
* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Enablement
* Request Fulfilment
* Service Level Management
* Work with the CMDB and Common Service Data Model to maintain service\-aware processes.
* Configure UI and data policies, client scripts, business rules, notifications, and other platform components.
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications using Studio and App Engine Studio.
* Build workflows and automations using Flow Designer and IntegrationHub.
* Configure Service Catalog items, record producers, approvals, and Virtual Agent topics.
* Develop and troubleshoot server\-side scripts using GlideRecord and related ServiceNow APIs.
* Create and consume REST APIs and work with Import Sets and Transform Maps.



 Salesforce Administration \& Development
 


* Configure Salesforce objects, fields, record pages, relationships, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and field\-level security.
* Design scalable Salesforce data models using lookup, master\-detail, and junction relationships.
* Build business automation using Salesforce Flow Builder.
* Configure validation rules, duplicate management, approval processes, reports, and dashboards.
* Develop Apex classes, triggers, and automation where declarative capabilities are insufficient.
* Write efficient SOQL queries and bulk\-safe DML operations.
* Develop and maintain Lightning Web Components.
* Implement appropriate unit testing and asynchronous processing.



 Integration \& Data Synchronisation
 


* Design and implement integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce.
* Work with authenticated APIs, OAuth 2\.0, named credentials, callouts, and platform events.
* Design canonical data models and appropriate integration patterns.
* Configure and support middleware/orchestration solutions such as
 **n8n or MuleSoft** 
 .
* Design conflict\-safe data synchronisation, including duplicate, retry, loop, and failure handling.
* Monitor integrations and troubleshoot data and API issues.



 Governance, Testing \& Release Management
 


* Follow platform governance and enterprise architecture standards.
* Manage platform changes across development, testing, and production environments.
* Work with ServiceNow Update Sets and Salesforce Change Sets/packages.
* Develop and execute automated and unit tests.
* Support release pipelines and controlled deployment processes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, integration documentation, and solution designs.
* Participate in design reviews and platform governance forums.
* Consider licensing, platform cost, maintainability, security, and upgrade impact when proposing solutions.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* Hands\-on experience with
 **ServiceNow administration/configuration** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Salesforce administration/configuration** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **ITIL 4 and ITSM concepts** 
 .
* Understanding of CRM processes and enterprise customer operations.
* Experience with ServiceNow:
* Tables and forms
* Roles and ACLs
* Flow Designer
* Service Catalog
* Business Rules
* Client Scripts
* GlideRecord
* IntegrationHub
* REST APIs
* Import Sets / Transform Maps
* CMDB
* Experience with Salesforce:
* Objects and data modelling
* Profiles and Permission Sets
* Sharing and security
* Flow Builder
* Apex
* SOQL
* Triggers
* Lightning Web Components
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and integration patterns.
* Experience with Git and version\-control practices.
* Experience using tools such as
 **Postman and Visual Studio Code** 
 .
* Ability to analyse business requirements and translate them into platform solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.



 Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills
 


* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or relevant ServiceNow certification.
* Salesforce Administrator certification and/or Salesforce Platform Developer certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow App Engine Studio.
* Experience with Salesforce CLI.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or n8n.
* Knowledge of Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* Experience designing cross\-platform integrations.
* Familiarity with automated testing and enterprise release management.
* Basic JavaScript or Python knowledge.



 Educational Qualification
 


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional certifications in ServiceNow, Salesforce, ITIL, or enterprise platforms are an advantage.



 Key Competencies
 


* Enterprise platform thinking
* ITSM and CRM process understanding
* Platform configuration and administration
* Workflow and process automation
* Scripting and application development
* API and systems integration
* Data modelling and security
* Troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis
* Testing and quality assurance
* Release and change management
* Technical documentation
* Stakeholder and business communication



 Typical Deliverables
 


* Configured ServiceNow and Salesforce platform components
* ITSM workflows and automation
* Salesforce flows and business automation
* Scripts, Apex, and Lightning Web Components
* ServiceNow–Salesforce integrations
* Data synchronisation mechanisms
* Test cases and automated tests
* Technical and configuration documentation
* Deployment packages and release documentation
* Platform governance and support documentation



 Success Profile
 



 The ideal candidate is comfortable working
 **between business processes and technology** 
 . They should be able to understand a business requirement, determine which platform should own the process or data, configure the solution where possible, develop code where necessary, integrate systems safely, test the result, and deploy it through a controlled release process.
 



 This role is particularly suited to professionals working as
 **Platform Administrators, Enterprise Consultants, ServiceNow Administrators, Salesforce Administrators, Platform Developers, or Cross\-Platform Technology Consultants** 
 .

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
The Data Technical Architect is the design authority for the data architecture that underpins the Command Centre and enables the Control Tower. The role owns how operational data from source systems across product domains is ingested, integrated, resolved, modelled, certified, and served as a single, trusted, near real‑time view of the business.
   

  

 This is a data‑architecture‑led role. The primary deliverable is the target‑state data architecture – layering, canonical models, event and entity design, the semantic and KPI layer, and the data quality and lineage framework – that allows the Control Tower to detect exceptions, trigger alerts, and support root‑cause analysis with confidence in the underlying data.
   

  

 The role works closely with Command Centre operations, BI delivery, Data Engineering, GDA, Data Platform, source system owners, and Enterprise Architecture, and operates within the standards set by the Tech Governance Lead.
   

  

 The Data Technical Architect is the design authority for the data architecture that underpins the Command Centre and enables the Control Tower. The role owns how operational data from source systems across product domains is ingested, integrated, resolved, modelled, certified, and served as a single, trusted, near real‑time view of the business.
   

  

 This is a data‑architecture‑led role. The primary deliverable is the target‑state data architecture – layering, canonical models, event and entity design, the semantic and KPI layer, and the data quality and lineage framework – that allows the Control Tower to detect exceptions, trigger alerts, and support root‑cause analysis with confidence in the underlying data.
   

  

 The role works closely with Command Centre operations, BI delivery, Data Engineering, GDA, Data Platform, source system owners, and Enterprise Architecture, and operates within the standards set by the Tech Governance Lead.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Data Architecture \& Design
   

  

 Own the end‑to‑end data architecture for the Command Centre – how data flows from operational source systems across product domains (e.g. Contracts, Ocean) through to the Control Tower consumption layer.
   

  

 Define the target‑state data architecture and transition roadmap, including the layering model (landing, raw, integrated/curated, consumption) and the storage, compute, and serving choices at each layer.
   

  

 Design the canonical, cross‑domain data layer that gives the Control Tower one consistent representation of the core business objects, independent of the source systems they originate from.
   

  

 Define master and reference data requirements, entity resolution, and cross‑system key mapping so that events from different systems resolve to the same business entity.
   

  

 Establish data domain boundaries, data ownership, and data product definitions aligned to the Command Centre operating model.
   

  

 Produce and maintain core architecture artefacts – conceptual, logical, and physical data models, data flow and lineage diagrams, integration maps, and architecture decision records.
   

  

 Data Integration \& Pipeline Architecture
   

  

 Architect real‑time, near real‑time, and batch ingestion patterns – streaming, event‑driven, CDC, API, and scheduled – and define which pattern applies to which source and use case.
   

  

 Define the operational event model and payload standards for the milestones, status changes, and exceptions that drive Control Tower views.
   

  

 Design pipeline patterns for reliability at scale: idempotency, replay, late‑arriving and out‑of‑order events, backfill, and reconciliation back to source.
   

  

 Set standards for orchestration, dependency management, error and dead‑letter handling, and pipeline observability.
   

  

 Define and agree data contracts and SLAs with source system teams, covering schema, frequency, volume, and change management.
   

  

 Define latency, freshness, and throughput targets per data domain and ensure the architecture demonstrably meets them.
   

  

 Data Modelling \& Semantic / KPI Layer
   

  

 Design the dimensional, event, and state models required for end‑to‑end milestone tracking, cycle time, dwell, and exception analysis.
   

  

 Architect the semantic and KPI layer so that each metric is defined once, certified, and reused consistently across Control Tower views and downstream reporting.
   

  

 Model for drill‑down, so an alert on the Control Tower can be traced to transaction‑level detail and root cause without leaving the platform.
   

  

 Define the historisation approach – slowly changing dimensions, snapshots, and point‑in‑time reporting – to support trend and retrospective analysis.
   

  

 Design aggregation, pre‑computation, and caching strategies so Control Tower dashboards meet response‑time expectations at production data volumes.
   

  

 Data Quality, Governance \& Security
   

  

 Define data quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds at each architectural layer, and design how failures are detected, quarantined, and escalated.
   

  

 Ensure Control Tower alerting is built on trusted data – design the freshness, completeness, and validity checks that gate what is surfaced to operations.
   

  

 Design end‑to‑end metadata and lineage capture, from source system field through to published KPI.
   

  

 Design role‑based access, row and column level security, masking, retention, and audit into the data architecture rather than bolting it on later.
   

  

 Ensure alignment with enterprise data architecture, cloud strategy, and BI governance standards, and work with the Tech Governance Lead on dataset certification.
   

  

 Identify, document, and drive remediation of data architecture technical debt.
   

  

 Delivery \& Execution
   

  

 Translate the architecture into sprint‑ready designs, data contracts, and backlog items for data engineering and BI delivery teams.
   

  

 Provide hands‑on technical direction – prototypes, proofs of concept, performance tuning, and resolution of complex modelling and pipeline problems.
   

  

 Review data models, pipelines, and semantic layers for adherence to the agreed architecture.
   

  

 Own volumetrics and capacity planning, and support performance, resilience, and reconciliation testing ahead of each Control Tower release.
   

  

 Drive reuse of data products, models, and patterns across Command Centre use cases to reduce duplication and rework.
   

  

 Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Collaboration
   

  

 Partner with Command Centre operations and business owners to translate operational visibility and exception‑management needs into concrete data requirements.
   

  

 Collaborate closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, GDA, source system owners, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure and Cloud teams.
   

  

 Present data architecture proposals to design authorities and governance forums for review and approval.
   

  

 Communicate data design trade‑offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to non‑technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Mentor data engineers and modellers on architecture patterns, modelling standards, and design quality.
   

  

**Required Qualifications / Skills**
 Education \& Experience
   

  

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 Extensive experience as a data architect designing large‑scale, multi‑source data platforms, with hands‑on delivery experience rather than documentation only.
   

  

 Proven experience designing the data architecture behind a control tower, command centre, or comparable real‑time operational visibility solution.
   

  

 Track record of integrating operational and transactional source systems across multiple business domains.
   

  

 Certifications in cloud data platforms, data architecture, or frameworks such as DAMA‑DMBOK or TOGAF are a plus.
   

  

 Technical Competencies
   

  

* Deep data modelling expertise – conceptual, logical, and physical modelling; dimensional (Kimball), Data Vault, and event/state modelling.
* Strong experience with cloud data platforms, lakehouse and warehouse architectures, and layered (medallion‑style) design.
* Hands‑on experience with streaming and event‑driven architectures, CDC, message/event platforms, and API‑based integration.
* Advanced SQL and data performance engineering – partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, query tuning, and cost optimisation.
* Experience with orchestration and transformation frameworks and with data quality and observability tooling.
* Working knowledge of master data management, reference data, and entity resolution techniques.
* Experience with metadata, lineage, and data catalogue tooling, and with certified dataset practices.
* Strong understanding of data security, privacy, compliance, and governance, and the ability to design to them.
* Sufficient BI and visualisation knowledge to design a semantic layer that Control Tower dashboards can consume efficiently.


 Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with source system owners.
   

  

 Ability to communicate complex data concepts clearly and effectively.
   

  

 High attention to detail combined with strategic, big‑picture thinking.
   

  

 Sound judgement under operational pressure and in incident‑driven environments.
   

  

 Proven ability to work across teams and drive alignment without direct authority.

**The Opportunity**
 As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise\-scale D365 F\&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value\-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.
* Lead the technical design and development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, with a focus on POS systems (MPOS/CPOS) \& B2C /B2B Website.
* Configure and extend Store Commerce, Hardware Station, and integrate peripherals such as printers, scanners, cash drawers, and payment devices.
* Configure and extend B2C \& B2B website, Site builder.
* Develop custom POS functionalities using Commerce SDK, Online SDK , TypeScript, JavaScript, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Implement integrations between POS and backend systems: ERP (F\&O), payment gateways, fiscal printers, loyalty programs, and eCommerce platforms.
* Design and maintain offline\-first POS architecture, ensuring performance, fault tolerance, and scalability across store networks.
* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business needs into detailed technical designs and functional design documents (FDDs).
* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post\-go\-live to resolve POS\-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* Ability to conceptualize and design future\-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi\-country and multi\-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**What We Look For**
* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full\-cycle D365 F\&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail \& eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.

 Senior/Expert IT Function Analyst
   

  

**Department** 
 : BNP Paribas Fortis, CBPS
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 BNP Paribas Fortis is one of the largest payment processors in Europe. New and existing IT technologies are being developed and maintained out of Tribe Payments in Brussels following the agile methodology. Our teams work in multi\-cultural and empowered squads who deliver new functionalities and enhancements on a frequent basis.
   

  

 The mission of the Tribe Payments is to grow as a reliable and cost\-efficient payment service provider for customers of BNP Paribas Group worldwide, whilst implementing innovative technologies and payment products.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 In this role you will be part of the SPTS (Specific Payments \& Transversal Services) squad with colleagues in Chennai and Belgium. The squad is responsible for the development and maintenance of a key payment application of BNP Paribas Fortis. It works in an agile mode with daily huddles and frequent production releases, whilst maintaining high quality standards.
   

  

 The squad is part of Tribe Payments with its main management in Belgium at BNP Paribas Fortis, a sister company of ISPL.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* As member of the SPTS (Specific Payments \& Transversal Services) squad you participate to the analysis, design, development, integration, test and support of qualitative Payment’s products, solutions and services in Java technology.
* Ensure together with the other squad members the implementation of Swagger APIs, maintenance and future improvements.
* Document the solutions.
* Understand the needs of the business and translate these needs into functional and technical analyses. These analyses are the input for the software developers.
* Assist the testers in test sets, creating test scenarios and solving complex defects


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Assist the squad product owner to refine the business requirements into functional and technical requirements via Features and User Stories.
* Collaborate with other squads at Tribe Payments and other Tribes within BNPP group.
* Ensure the 3rd line support.
* Provide support to the production team in case of incidents.
* Actively promote the T\-shaping in the Squad by passing on your own knowledge to colleagues and taking on other tasks yourself if necessary.
* You stand guard over quality and organization.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
**Specific Qualifications**
* You have a bachelor or master degree in IT and at least 7 years of experience
* Fluent English is mandatory (oral and written)

**Skills Referential**

* Business experience
* Knowledge and experience of banking and payment products.
* Experience in process analysis of payments requirements.
* Functional Analysis
* Knowledge of analysis methodology
* Technical experience
* Functional and technical knowledge involving Distributed systems built with Java.
* Knowledge and experience in building Swagger APIs.
* Agile and Scrum experience

* Team player who promotes communication between internal and external stakeholders.
* Result oriented: adapts to the context and wants to obtain the best possible result considering available means.
* Act and analyse proactively.
* Pragmatic and problem solver.
* Quick self\-starter, pro\-active attitude, self\-motivated.
* Good communication skills.
* Ability to work in a dynamic and multi\-cultural environment. .

* Ability to collaborate with stakeholders.
* Asking and giving feedback.

 Bachelor Degree or equivalent
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group.  At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. You will collaborate with engineering, security, and product teams to translate business requirements into production\-ready AI agent solutions.

* Evaluate and integrate LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, etc.), defining model selection strategies, prompt engineering standards, and token budget management across agent tiers and multi\-tenant data layers
* Design vendor integration patterns using direct APIs, MCP, and A2A protocol for complex HR platform workflows.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures from user interaction through agent orchestration, vendor API integration, and production deployment with monitoring.

* Working knowledge of multi\-tenant security patterns
* (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent) for architecture work, design documentation, and engineering workflows. Familiarity with agentic engineering patterns is expected.
* Strong communication and documentation skills; ability to influence cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocol for vendor and cross\-system integrations.
* Experience integrating with HR/HCM platforms
* Experience with LangFuse, LangSmith, or similar LLM observability and tracing platforms.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices: PII handling, prompt injection defense, model risk management, and explainability.
* — working familiarity with cloud\-native deployment (Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, observability), data engineering patterns (ETL/ELT, lakehouse, streaming), and the operational implications for AI platforms. Not expected to own these, but must collaborate effectively with Cloud Solution and Data Integration architects in joint reviews.


****Key Competencies****
* Architecture leadership with pragmatic trade\-off decisions (speed vs. risk, cost vs. accuracy, build vs. buy, direct integration vs. protocol abstraction).
* Ability to bridge AI research and engineering \- turning prototypes into reliable, observable production services.

title: Lead Software Architect
description:
Lead software Architect
 



 Wualt (primary), with architectural oversight of Nexus
 



 Full\-time · Chennai, India (Hybrid)
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



 Wualt is a personal\-safety platform. Someone wearing a smart ring, or simply carrying their phone, can raise an SOS and get help quickly, with their live location and audio shared to trusted guardians and a staffed response centre, and AI that helps flag genuine distress. It spans mobile apps, web consoles, and cloud back\-end services.
 



  





 We are looking for a Lead Technical Architect to own the architecture of Wualt as our current architect transitions out. This is a hands\-on leadership role, and Wualt is your primary focus. To start, you will be a team of one: you will pick up the existing codebase and take it through to deployment across all of Wualt's apps and web apps yourself, and build a team around you over time. You will also provide architectural oversight of Nexus, our apparel manufacturing platform, at a guidance level rather than day to day. We want a genuine polyglot who sets the technical direction, keeps the product secure and scalable, and raises the bar on engineering and product quality.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 • Wualt's architecture, end to end: the mobile apps, the web consoles, the back\-end services and APIs, and the cloud infrastructure underneath.
 



 • The system\-level decisions: technology choices, service boundaries, data flows, and build\-versus\-buy calls. You own the trade\-offs and you document them.
 



 • Real\-time reliability for safety\-critical flows. When someone raises an alarm, the live experience has to be fast and it cannot drop. You design for that.
 



 • Architecture for scale, so the product stays fast and dependable as usage grows.
 



 • Security and privacy as a first\-class concern: airtight security in every layer, and data handling architected to comply with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA).
 



 • The quality of the front\-end experience across mobile and web, in partnership with design. Fast, polished, and a genuine pleasure to use.
 



 • A pragmatic use of AI tooling to build faster and build more, while keeping full ownership of the architecture and engineering judgment. AI accelerates the work. It does not make the decisions.
 



 • AI and ML in the product. We use AI and ML capabilities, and you own integrating them into the platform reliably and securely.
 



 • The team, over time. To start you are the team, hands\-on across the whole platform. As we grow, you build and lead a lean engineering team: design and code reviews, engineering standards, and mentoring.
 



 • A clean handover from the outgoing architect, with full ownership of Wualt within 30 days of joining
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 • A clear track record of shipping enterprise\-grade applications and products to production, at scale.
 



 • Strong across our core technologies: React Native for mobile, React for web, and Python and Django on the back end, on AWS.
 



 • A genuine polyglot. You move comfortably between languages and frameworks, choose the right tool rather than forcing one stack, and can give sound architectural guidance on systems built in stacks other than your primary one.
 



 • Real\-time, event\-driven systems. Experience building live, low\-latency features (for example WebSockets or streaming media) that stay reliable under load.
 



 • Strong database design experience across relational and NoSQL stores, for example PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
 



 • Hands\-on experience architecting for data protection and privacy, including the DPDPA, or comparable regimes such as the GDPR.
 



 • A security\-first mindset, with real experience designing secure systems: authentication and authorization, encryption, secrets management, and threat modeling.
 



 • A strong product and front\-end sensibility. You care how the software looks and feels, not only how it runs.
 



 • A base\-level understanding of AI and ML systems. We use AI and ML in the product and you will integrate it into the platform, so you need to be comfortable working with models and ML services, even if you are not an ML researcher.
 



 • Fluency with AI\-assisted development, and the maturity to treat it as an accelerant to your own architectural reasoning rather than a substitute for it.
 



  





 NICE TO HAVE
 



 • Wearables, IoT, or BLE and connected\-device experience, and data\-intensive or machine\-learning\-backed products.
 



 • Enterprise or ERP domain experience across manufacturing, supply chain, or procurement, useful for the Nexus oversight side.
 



 • Cloud and DevOps depth: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability.
 



 • Experience as the senior\-most engineer on a platform, or leading a small team.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



 • First 30 days: a full context transfer from the outgoing architect, and a documented map of Wualt, its risks, and the near\-term priorities, plus a lighter read on Nexus.
 



 • By 60 days: a prioritized architecture and security roadmap for Wualt with the highest\-risk gaps already closing, and a working oversight rhythm for Nexus.
 



 • By 90 days: you are the clear technical owner of Wualt, decisions move quickly, the team is shipping against your roadmap, and Nexus is guided at the right altitude.
 



  





 LOCATION AND TYPE
 



 Full\-time, based in Chennai, hybrid with regular on\-site collaboration. You will work directly with the founders and a lean in\-house and partner engineering team.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



 Apply through this LinkedIn posting, and email your resume to sunil@armortrixtech.com. A short note on one system you architected end to end, the trade\-offs you made, and what you would do differently now is welcome, along with links to shipped products or a portfolio.

description:
Job Title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect


Division: Assessment \& Qualifications Delivery


Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid)


**Role Summary**

As a Solution Architect (E30\), you will design and deliver new services on Microsoft Azure aligned with Pearson’s enterprise standards. Your remit includes the development of secure, scalable solution architectures, while ensuring integration across legacy on\-premise and AWS components where needed. You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non\-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end\-to\-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on\-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non\-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.
* Solution Option Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Work with business analysts and product owners to evaluate multiple solution options, ensuring the trade\-offs are understood. Provide cost and effort estimations (including infrastructure, licensing and operational considerations), and help recommend solutions that balance performance, scalability and total cost of ownership.
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as design authority throughout delivery. Provide guidance, mentoring and quality assurance to delivery teams and third\-party partners. Develop and refine architectural standards where gaps exist to ensure consistent best practices.
* Support Delivery Teams: Collaborate closely with delivery teams—including technical architects, developers, testers and DevOps engineers—to interpret and implement architecture designs correctly. Assist with troubleshooting technical issues, and ensure that Technical Architects and developers share a common understanding of architecture decisions and design patterns.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with product owners, business analysts, subject matter experts and external partners to refine requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment and shared understanding.
* Vendor Oversight: Work with third\-party delivery teams, reviewing their architectures, holding them accountable to Pearson’s standards and supporting them in meeting quality targets.
* Documentation \& Planning: Produce system diagrams, interface specifications and implementation roadmaps. Ensure design decisions are thoroughly documented and communicated.
* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Monitor industry trends and evaluate new technologies (e.g. infrastructure automation, AI, data platforms) for relevance to Pearson. Propose enhancements that support robust, modern and cost\-effective solutions.
* Compliance \& Security: Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson’s security and data privacy standards. Participate in design reviews and governance forums to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture policies.
* Lifecycle Support: Support implementation teams from development through deployment, addressing technical issues and ensuring solutions deliver the intended business value.

**Essential Experience \& Skills**

* Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: Proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions, with a strong emphasis on Azure cloud services and cloud\-native principles.
* Architecture \& Design Expertise: Ability to produce architecture blueprints, dataflows, integration diagrams and detailed specifications.
* Cloud Proficiency: Deep understanding of Azure compute, storage, networking, security and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. ARM, Terraform). Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices.
* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Experience overseeing design implementation, defining architectural standards and providing technical guidance to teams and vendors.
* Solution Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Ability to evaluate solution options and provide well\-reasoned recommendations based on technical fit, effort and cost.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication and interpersonal skills; able to articulate architecture rationale to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and foster alignment.
* Problem Solving \& Adaptability: Proven analytical skills and adaptability; comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting solutions as requirements evolve.
* Business Insight: Ability to balance technology decisions with business outcomes to ensure solutions deliver value.
* Education \& Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g. BCS Intermediate Certificate in Enterprise Architecture, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly regarded.

**Desirable Skills**

* Knowledge of relational databases, data modelling and data analytics solutions.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with Agile methodologies, TDD and other modern development practices.
* Programming/scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python).
* Good understanding of AWS PaaS services (such as RDS/SQL, SNS, Aurora) to support integrated or legacy components.
* Understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Awareness of AI/ML and emerging technologies and their impact on architecture.

**Job Location and Hours**

The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45 hour week. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires our team to work from their base office 3 times per week.


**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.


Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.  Microservices architecture, event\-driven and streaming systems, Kafka, and Google Cloud Pub/Sub and EventArc.

 GKE, Cloud Run, Vertex AI and Gen AI services, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL), Memorystore, Cloud Armor, Global and External Load Balancing, Apigee, Cloud Logging, Cloud Storage buckets, Secret Manager, EventArc, Pub/Sub, and IAM.
 



  





**Containers \& orchestration:** 
 Docker and Kubernetes — image optimisation, autoscaling, resource limits, and health probes.
 



  





**Infrastructure as code:** 
 Terraform.
 



  





**CI/CD:** 
 Tekton and GitHub Actions, with Git\-based branching strategy and cloud deployment best practices.

 Pytest, test\-driven development, and automated quality gates in the pipeline.

 Dynatrace.

 Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and the full SDLC.

**Job Summary**

The role combines deep technical expertise with strong collaboration skills to deliver innovative, reliable, and efficient platform capabilities across multiple business domains. A key focus of this position is supporting the migration and consolidation of ServiceNow environments, ensuring the successful transition of applications, integrations, workflows, and data while minimizing business disruption. The role contributes to platform standardization, technical governance, and continuous improvement initiatives, helping drive operational excellence and long\-term platform sustainability. Working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Infrastructure teams, Security teams, and external partners, the ServiceNow Developer E4 will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, promote development best practices, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and service management standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform, including custom applications, workflows, automations, and integrations.
* Configure and enhance core ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, and related platform modules.
* Develop and support integrations with internal and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, and other ServiceNow integration capabilities.
* Support the ongoing maintenance and evolution of the ServiceNow platform, including version upgrades, architectural improvements, platform performance, and technical governance.
* Play a key role in ServiceNow platform migration and consolidation initiatives, supporting application assessment, solution redesign, configuration migration, and data transition activities.
* Ensure solution quality through testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and adherence to ServiceNow development best practices and governance standards.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, Infrastructure, Security, and vendor teams to deliver business\-driven platform enhancements.
* Contribute to Agile delivery, continuous improvement initiatives, and the long\-term roadmap of the ServiceNow platform.


**Employees At All Levels Are Expected To**
* 7 to 10 years of proven experience delivering solutions across core ServiceNow capabilities, including ITSM, Service Catalogue, CMDB, Knowledge Management, Flow Designer, and Integration Hub.
* Experience supporting the full ServiceNow platform lifecycle, including version upgrades, architectural evolution, performance optimization, and technical governance.
* Experience contributing to ServiceNow migration, consolidation, or transformation initiatives, including the assessment of customizations, integrations, and data migration requirements. Exposure to mergers, acquisitions, or large\-scale platform integration programs would be beneficial.
* Experience with Discovery, Service Mapping, or other platform capabilities would be preferrable.
* Strong development skills in JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting frameworks, with the ability to design scalable, maintainable, and high\-performing solutions.
* Experience designing and implementing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and connecting ServiceNow with enterprise applications and services.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders in Agile delivery environments complete your profile.
* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA are highly valued, while CAD, CIS, or other advanced ServiceNow certifications are considered preferrable.
